purpose: Human/agent inspection registry for candidate TIBER-Data fields that may eventually feed Point-prediction-model. This is not ingestion, scoring, or downstream wiring.
scope_boundary: Entries describe semantics and readiness only. A field marked candidate or needs_verification is not a claim of complete source-backed coverage.

entries.description: Canonical player identifier for joining player-week, roster, and outcome evidence rows.
entries.owner_source: TIBER-Data player identity / player-week evidence lanes
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Required identifier in current weekly player contracts; rows without a usable player_id should fail validation or be excluded by the producing lane.
entries.provenance_expectations: Must be carried from governed player-week source normalization or promoted evidence artifacts; no synthetic identifiers.
notes_open_questions: Confirm downstream identity namespace expectations before any future wiring.

entries.description: Human-readable player display/name field for inspection and auditability, not a stable join key.
entries.owner_source: TIBER-Data player identity / player-week evidence lanes
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Expected on promoted evidence rows that expose player_name; do not use as fallback when player_id is missing.
entries.provenance_expectations: Carried from source-backed or fixture-backed evidence rows with source provenance preserved.
notes_open_questions: weekly_player_stats names this concept full_name; adapters must not silently collapse name fields without an explicit mapping.

entries.description: Team abbreviation for the player-week or team-level context row.
entries.owner_source: TIBER-Data player-week and team context lanes
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Required on current player-week and team-context contracts; no fabricated team abbreviations.
entries.provenance_expectations: Must be source-normalized or carried from promoted artifacts with duplicate-key validation by the producer.
notes_open_questions: Future model adapters should define how team changes inside a season are represented.

entries.description: Player position code used for position-specific feature gating and inspection.
entries.owner_source: TIBER-Data player-week evidence lanes
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Required on current player-week contracts; unsupported positions should be filtered by downstream consumers rather than rewritten.
entries.provenance_expectations: Carried from source normalization or promoted evidence artifacts.
notes_open_questions: Confirm whether downstream consumers require position_group or exact roster position.

entries.description: NFL season key for player-week and team-context rows.
entries.owner_source: TIBER-Data evidence lanes
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Required in existing contracts and promoted artifact rows.
entries.provenance_expectations: Must come from source rows or governed export parameters; no continuity beyond supported seasons.
notes_open_questions: Do not widen season support based on this semantics registry.

entries.description: NFL week key for player-week rows.
entries.owner_source: TIBER-Data player-week evidence lanes
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Required for weekly player artifacts; no synthetic missing-week rows should be inserted by semantics tooling.
entries.provenance_expectations: Carried from source rows or governed weekly export keys.
notes_open_questions: Downstream consumers must separately decide regular-season versus postseason policy.

entries.description: Routes run per game over a defined sample window.
entries.owner_source: Derived from player_weekly_usage_v1 routes_run when source support exists
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: May be null when routes_run is unavailable; source-backed usage docs explicitly preserve unsupported route fields as null.
entries.provenance_expectations: Requires explicit sample window and route source provenance; do not backfill from position averages.
notes_open_questions: Define per-game denominator: games active, games with route source, or all team games.

entries.description: Share/participation measure for a player's routes relative to available pass-route opportunities.
entries.owner_source: player_weekly_usage_v1 fixture/source-backed usage lane
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Fixture rows may be populated; source-backed rows may be null when unsupported. Null must remain null.
entries.provenance_expectations: Must retain source provenance and distinguish fixture-backed support from source-backed availability.
notes_open_questions: Confirm exact denominator before direct model use.

entries.description: Targets divided by routes run for receiving role inspection.
entries.owner_source: Derivable from targets and routes_run when both are supported
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Null when routes_run is null, zero, or outside the governed sample definition.
entries.provenance_expectations: Must cite both targets and routes_run sources plus denominator handling.
notes_open_questions: Existing schema uses tprr naming; decide whether model-facing name should remain targets_per_route.

entries.description: Receiving targets per game over an explicit sample window.
entries.owner_source: Derived from weekly_player_stats or player_weekly_usage_v1 targets
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Null if target source or sample denominator is unavailable; do not infer from receptions.
entries.provenance_expectations: Requires explicit sample window, game eligibility definition, and source artifact path.
notes_open_questions: Choose rolling versus season-to-date semantics before downstream use.

entries.description: Rushing attempts/carries per game over an explicit sample window.
entries.owner_source: Derived from weekly_player_stats rushing_attempts or player_weekly_usage_v1 rushing_attempts
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Null if rushing attempts or sample denominator are unavailable; zero only when source row states zero attempts.
entries.provenance_expectations: Requires explicit carry source and sample-window denominator.
notes_open_questions: Decide whether QB designed rushes and scrambles need separate semantics.

entries.description: Passing attempts per game over an explicit sample window.
entries.owner_source: Derived from weekly_player_stats pass_attempts when available
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Null if passing attempts or sample denominator are unavailable; non-QB rows should be governed explicitly rather than silently zeroed for modeling.
entries.provenance_expectations: Requires source pass_attempts support and sample-window denominator.
notes_open_questions: Current weekly_player_stats notes pass_attempts can be zero-filled for non-passers; downstream QB-only use should avoid positional leakage.

entries.description: Receiving yards divided by targets over a defined sample.
entries.owner_source: Derived from weekly_player_stats or player_weekly_usage_v1 receiving_yards/targets when available
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Null when targets are zero or missing; do not coerce divide-by-zero to zero.
entries.provenance_expectations: Must cite receiving yard and target sources plus denominator policy.
notes_open_questions: Decide whether weekly volatility should be smoothed before model use.

entries.description: Rushing yards divided by rushing attempts over a defined sample.
entries.owner_source: Derived from weekly_player_stats rushing_yards/rushing_attempts
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Null when carries are zero or missing; zero only if source yards and attempts imply zero with positive attempts.
entries.provenance_expectations: Must cite rushing yard and attempt sources plus denominator policy.
notes_open_questions: QB rushing efficiency may need separate treatment from RB rushing efficiency.

entries.description: Receiving yards divided by receptions over a defined sample.
entries.owner_source: Derived from weekly_player_stats receiving_yards/receptions
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Null when receptions are zero or missing; do not fabricate from targets.
entries.provenance_expectations: Must cite receiving yard and reception sources plus denominator policy.
notes_open_questions: May duplicate yards_per_target signal; inspect before keeping both.

entries.description: Receptions divided by targets over a defined sample.
entries.owner_source: Derived from weekly_player_stats or player_weekly_usage_v1 receptions/targets
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Null when targets are zero or missing; do not infer catches from yards.
entries.provenance_expectations: Must cite target and reception sources plus denominator policy.
notes_open_questions: Consider whether catch_rate is factual box-score derivation or model-smoothed feature in downstream repo.

entries.description: Passing yards divided by pass attempts over a defined sample.
entries.owner_source: Derived from weekly_player_stats passing_yards/pass_attempts
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Null when pass_attempts are zero or missing.
entries.provenance_expectations: Must cite passing yard and attempt sources plus denominator policy.
notes_open_questions: Model consumers should decide whether sacks/team pass efficiency belong in a separate context feature.

entries.description: Receiving touchdowns per receiving opportunity over a defined sample, usually per target or reception.
entries.owner_source: Derivable from weekly_player_stats receiving_tds with a governed denominator
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Null until denominator is explicitly selected and available; do not infer touchdown dependency without support.
entries.provenance_expectations: Requires source receiving_tds plus documented denominator and sample window.
notes_open_questions: Choose denominator: target, reception, route, or game.

entries.description: Rushing touchdowns per rushing opportunity over a defined sample.
entries.owner_source: Derivable from weekly_player_stats rushing_tds/rushing_attempts
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Null until denominator and sample window are governed.
entries.provenance_expectations: Requires source rushing_tds plus documented opportunity denominator.
notes_open_questions: Goal-line opportunity may be more useful than aggregate TD rate but is not fully established here.

entries.description: Passing touchdowns per passing opportunity over a defined sample.
entries.owner_source: Derivable from weekly_player_stats passing_tds/pass_attempts
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Null when pass attempts are unavailable, zero, or outside the governed sample.
entries.provenance_expectations: Requires passing_tds and pass_attempts source support plus denominator policy.
notes_open_questions: Downstream model should decide whether this is too outcome-dependent for projection inputs.

entries.description: End-zone targets per game over an explicit sample window.
entries.owner_source: No governed TIBER-Data source identified in this registry
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Not available until a governed end-zone target source is added; leave null/not consumed.
entries.provenance_expectations: Would require explicit end-zone target source provenance and sample-window denominator.
notes_open_questions: Current docs reference red_zone_targets, not end_zone_targets.

entries.description: Player red-zone targets divided by team red-zone targets over a defined sample.
entries.owner_source: Partially derivable if player and team red-zone target denominators are both governed
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Null when player red_zone_targets or team denominator is unavailable; do not infer from touchdowns.
entries.provenance_expectations: Requires player red-zone target provenance plus a governed team denominator.
notes_open_questions: Registry has known player red_zone_targets references but no verified team red-zone target denominator for share.

entries.description: Carries inside the opponent 10-yard line per game over an explicit sample.
entries.owner_source: No governed TIBER-Data source identified in this registry
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Not available until a governed inside-10 carry source is added; leave null/not consumed.
entries.provenance_expectations: Would require play-location or high-value carry source provenance.
notes_open_questions: player_weekly_usage_v1 has red_zone_carries, not inside_10_carries.

entries.description: Interpretable rushing touchdown opportunity signal from high-value carries and team goal-line context.
entries.owner_source: No single governed TIBER-Data source identified; would be derived from high-value rush opportunity support
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Not consumed until formula and source coverage are governed; do not synthesize from touchdowns alone.
entries.provenance_expectations: Requires documented formula, source high-value carry fields, and source coverage notes.
notes_open_questions: Potentially model-derived rather than TIBER-Data-owned semantics.

entries.description: Count of games included in a rolling or season-to-date feature sample.
entries.owner_source: Derived by any future projection-input adapter from supported weekly rows
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Should be zero or null only under an explicit adapter policy; this registry does not create sampled aggregates.
entries.provenance_expectations: Must cite included artifact rows, filters, and game eligibility policy.
notes_open_questions: Define whether inactive games count against the denominator.

entries.description: Interpretive score or label describing whether player role has been stable over the sample.
entries.owner_source: No governed TIBER-Data formula identified
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Not available until a governed formula exists; do not consume as a real field.
entries.provenance_expectations: Would require explicit formula, input field provenance, and versioned thresholds.
notes_open_questions: Likely belongs in a downstream modeling repo unless TIBER-Data defines a pure evidence metric.

entries.description: Interpretive signal indicating how much a player's fantasy production depends on touchdowns.
entries.owner_source: No governed TIBER-Data formula identified
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Not available until a governed formula exists; do not consume as a real field.
entries.provenance_expectations: Would require outcome/source fields and clear threshold/version governance.
notes_open_questions: May be a model diagnostic rather than source-data semantic.

entries.description: Interpretive risk signal for injury or availability concerns.
entries.owner_source: No governed TIBER-Data injury source identified
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Not available; do not synthesize or proxy from missed games in this registry.
entries.provenance_expectations: Would require a governed injury/availability source and update-time semantics.
notes_open_questions: High risk of crossing into product/model judgment; keep out until source and ownership are clear.

entries.description: Team pass tendency context, including neutral pass rate and pass rate over expected where supported.
entries.owner_source: team_pace_pass_environment_v1 evidence lane
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Nullable fields must follow the team_pace_pass_environment_v1 null policy; fixture-only coverage must not be over-claimed.
entries.provenance_expectations: Must preserve team context artifact provenance and fixture/source lane label.
notes_open_questions: Current promoted lane is bounded historical_backtest fixture support, not full league truth.

entries.description: Team pace context such as plays per game or seconds per snap where supported.
entries.owner_source: team_pace_pass_environment_v1 evidence lane
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Use documented nullable handling for seconds_per_snap; do not fill missing pace fields.
entries.provenance_expectations: Must preserve team context artifact provenance and fixture/source lane label.
notes_open_questions: Decide whether Point-prediction-model wants raw pace fields or an adapter summary.

entries.description: Team offensive quality context such as points per game, yards per play, scoring rates, and optional efficiency metrics.
entries.owner_source: team_offense_summary_v1 evidence lane
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Nullable fields must follow team_offense_summary_v1 null policy; fixture-only coverage must not be over-claimed.
entries.provenance_expectations: Must preserve team offense artifact provenance and fixture/source lane label.
notes_open_questions: Current lane is bounded evidence inspection and does not alter scoring.

entries.description: Opponent defensive or matchup context for a player-week projection input.
entries.owner_source: No governed TIBER-Data opponent context source identified in this registry
entries.nullability_missing_behavior: Not available until a governed opponent-context artifact exists; do not synthesize from team names or schedule alone.
entries.provenance_expectations: Would require explicit opponent artifact, temporal alignment policy, and source provenance.
notes_open_questions: Likely needs its own contract before any projection-input adapter can consume it.
